description: LIVE Aave V3 position risk priced by AaveOracle at the current block, not by the V3 subgraph. Subgraph oracle snapshots can lag badly (a collateral health factor then looks safer than it is). Reads Pool.getUserAccountData, getReservesList, and e-mode; PoolDataProvider user balances, configuration, caps, aToken supply, total debt, and rates; AaveOracle.getAssetPrice. Returns block timestamp, health factor, collateral and debt USD, current LTV, max LTV, weighted liquidation threshold, per-asset collateral (amount, USD, LTV, liquidation threshold, used-as-collateral, supply APY) and debt (variable/stable, borrow APY). Scenarios: health factor after a joint drop of all non-stable collateral by each shock percent, the joint drop that reaches HF 1, and each collateral asset's price at HF 1 holding the others constant ('cannot liquidate alone' when HF stays above 1 at price 0). Also the repay of each debt asset or collateral add needed to reach targetHealthFactor (0 if already above), borrow and withdraw headroom at that target, and risk flags: LTV-0 collateral (counts toward HF, adds no borrow power, blocks withdrawing other collateral), frozen or paused reserves, supply caps over 95% full with remaining headroom, single-asset concentration, and a subgraph-vs-oracle warning above 2% when GRAPH_API_KEY is set. E-mode uses the category LTV and liquidation threshold for assets on the collateral bitmap, and a non-zero category price source. Markets: ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche — add one by extending the V3 market map (Pool, PoolDataProvider, Oracle). Optional rpcUrl overrides ETHEREUM_RPC_URL / BASE_RPC_URL / ...; otherwise public fallbacks are used (Ethereum starts at https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com).

chain.description: V3 market: ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche

rpcUrl.description: Optional JSON-RPC URL for this call. When omitted, the chain's *_RPC_URL env var is used, then public fallbacks.

shocks.description: Percent drops applied jointly to every non-stable collateral asset. Default [5, 10, 20, 30, 50].

targetHealthFactor.description: Health factor to reach by repaying or adding collateral, and the floor for borrow/withdraw headroom. Default 1.8.

name: get_v3_position_risk
